title: How I built this
description: A vibrant scene capturing the energy of musical storytelling across generations. Bold color and expressive figure work animate the sense of collective memory.

title: John Templeton Prize
description: Two figures hold their ground at the intersection of identity and cultural friction. The tension between subjects dissolves into an explosion of abstract geometry.

title: AADL Mural
description: A portrait rendered in warmth — the subject radiates presence against a fragmented, celebratory backdrop. Joy as resistance.

title: Editorial
description: A sea of red in motion through city streets. The crowd becomes texture, the individual disappears — and somehow becomes more visible.

title: Sketchbook
description: My Sketchbook is exactly what it sounds like - a running record of observation, instinct, and curiosity. No agenda, just the work of a restless eye moving through the world.

title: Music Stuff
description: is an ongoing portrait series celebrating the faces of hip-hop - from Kendrick Lamar to Rick Ross to Drake - rendered with bold line and raw instinct. Each sketch is a study in presence, capturing the artists who shape the culture as much as the music.
